# Template provenance

Retrieved 24 September 2026 from official CTAN distribution packages.

- `acmart.cls`: acmart 2.20, dated 16 August 2026. Generated without class-code modifications from `acmart.dtx` using the package's docstrip recipe. The extraction wrapper set an empty output directory prefix for Tectonic; it did not change class code. Upstream source and README are retained under `acmart/` as required by the LPPL notice. `ACM-Reference-Format.bst` is the unmodified distributed BibTeX style. Source: https://mirrors.ctan.org/macros/latex/contrib/acmart.zip
- `llncs.cls` and `splncs04.bst`: unmodified files from the official Springer LNCS distribution, class 2.26 dated 25 February 2025. Upstream notices and provenance are under `llncs/`. Source: https://mirrors.ctan.org/macros/latex/contrib/llncs.zip

These template licenses apply to the supplied template files, not automatically to the authored manuscript. No license for the manuscript is asserted on behalf of its author.
